mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.point_type (id, tenant_id, program_id, code, name, redeemable, tier_calculable, record_only, consumption_policy, validity_type, validity_period, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{redeemable}, #{tierCalculable}, #{recordOnly}, #{consumptionPolicy}, #{validityType}, #{validityPeriod}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, program_id, code, name, redeemable, tier_calculable, record_only, consumption_policy, validity_type, validity_period, status, created_at, updated_at FROM loyalty.point_type WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND id = #{id}
